title: 「桃」Peach totem
description: Legends of the Three Kingdoms (LTK) Peach totem
body:
During the action phase, a player can use a Peach to recover 1 unit of health for themselves.
When another character is on the brink of death, a Peach can be used to rescue them.
————————————————————————

The above is the official description of the Peach in LTK.

————————————————————————

This pack changes the Totem to the Peach card.
